blocking_reason: The available subagent execution surface returns final messages but not a complete, parseable rollout trace with task tool-call count, task context-token estimate, truncation status, and per-episode usage. Running the 14 trials without that telemetry would produce unverifiable actual_usage and violate R3 hard-budget enforcement.
budget_binding_policy: For budget_saturation_case trials, real calibration must show at least one method-baseline trial reaching >=90% of a budget dimension or being mechanically truncated. budget_binding null or low observed usage is not accepted.
negative_control_policy: For load-bearing episode cases, no-method and append-only arms require equivalent prompts and budgets plus auditable actual_usage. They were not run because the same telemetry gap applies.
case_design_status: case-flow dry-run valid; real baseline calibration pending a telemetry-capable execution runner
